A new episode of 9to5Mac Daily is recorded every weekday. Subscribe on Apple Podcasts or your favourite podcast player to make sure each new episode is delivered as soon as it's released.

Today's news discussed in this episode:

  • AT&T appears to have no plans to support Handoff on Apple's new iPhone
  • Disney+ and Hulu raise prices again—here are the latest fees
  • Apple says a software update to fix the iPhone 18 Pro reboot bug will roll out next week
